svg.title: Portfolio
svg.desc: Animated banner: an Engineer lane and a Creator lane scroll past each other, then fold into a grid of nine rooms.

g.text: Two halves scroll past each other, then
ENGINEER / ENGINEER / ENGINEER / ENGINEER / ENGINEER / ENGINEER / ENGINEER / ENGINEER / ENGINEER / ENGINEER /
CREATOR / CREATOR / CREATOR / CREATOR / CREATOR / CREATOR / CREATOR / CREATOR / CREATOR / CREATOR /
